findings.issue: The TSDoc comments on `apiVersion` and `kind` omit details required by unit U06 and Decision 1 in `change_plan.md`: `apiVersion` does not mention that it accepts both `'backstage.io/v1alpha1'` and `'backstage.io/v1beta1'`, and `kind` does not state that `'Resource'` is the literal value expected by this type and its validator schema.
findings.fix: Update the `apiVersion` TSDoc comment to note that it accepts both `'backstage.io/v1alpha1'` and `'backstage.io/v1beta1'`, and update the `kind` TSDoc comment to state that `'Resource'` is the literal value expected by this type and its validator schema (without saying it is 'always' `'Resource'`).
